specialLock.label: Third Note
specialLock.prompt: Sing the word carved above both bell lungs.

customItems.name: Storm Note
customItems.description: A bell-note folded into metal. Three harmonize into a silence strong enough to end the choir.
customItems.customDescription: A bell-note folded into metal. Three harmonize into a silence strong enough to end the choir.

intro.text: A storm temple keeps singing after every storm has passed. The song is not worship anymore. It is rehearsal for a thunderclap big enough to split the valley.

outro.text: The three storm notes collapse into a single clean silence. Rain finally falls outside, not as a weapon, but as weather.

storyTriggers.title: Dry Rain
storyTriggers.text: Raindrops hang in the air without falling. They tremble whenever anyone breathes.

storyTriggers.title: The Humming Nave
storyTriggers.text: The whole room hums one note too low for comfort. Your teeth learn it before your ears do.

storyTriggers.title: First Note
storyTriggers.text: The bell coughs up a sliver of blue metal that still sounds after it stops moving.

storyTriggers.title: Second Note
storyTriggers.text: The second bell note tries to fly away. It settles only when held near the first.

storyTriggers.title: The Caller Conducts
storyTriggers.text: The Tempest Choir Caller lifts both hands. Every loose object in the room rises like an audience about to applaud.
